name: Farseer

bonuses.name: Architect of Fate
bonuses.text: When a Farseer's turn begins, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: A Farseer may use Ruin Actions and has 4 personal Ruin. They may activate the Move Ruin Action during their own turn.

bonuses.name: Ghosthelm
bonuses.text: Farseers never roll on the Perils of the Warp table. They always use the Unbound Power Level (+1 Wrath Die).

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

abilities.name: Runes of Fate
abilities.text: The Farseer may attempt to activate one of the following psychic powers: Smite (Wrath & Glory page 272), Forewarning (page 274), Misfortune (page 274), Guide (below).

abilities.name: Guide
abilities.text: DN 5, Action. An ally within 15m gains +6 bonus dice on their next attack Test. Spend 1 Shift per additional +1 bonus die on the attack Test, or 1 Shift per additional 5m of range.

abilities.name: The Path of the Seer
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to activate a Psychic Power or Deny the Witch (Wrath & Glory page 267).

determination: Power Field: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. Farseers can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
